item_description:
Script: dpe tshugs.
Two sets of folio numbers, diverging after fol. 93. The first set continues with 94 to 97. The second set considers that 94 and 95 occur on one page, followed by 96 to 98 (98 is the number of folios reported in [8H6M69W4]).
